# reactableEdit

![reactable edit badge with an editing cursor in
edit](reference/figures/reactable-edit.svg)

**reactableEdit** is an independent fork of
[reactable](https://github.com/glin/reactable), originally developed by
Greg Lin. Maintained by Samuel JOBERT, it adds native Shiny cell
editing, server validation, configurable input states, row addition and
removal, and rich tooltips. It is not an official release of the
original project.

Development and issue reports:
<https://github.com/samuel-jobert/reactableEdit>. This development fork
is not currently published on CRAN.

Interactive data tables for R, based on the [React
Table](https://github.com/tanstack/table/tree/v7) library and made with
[reactR](https://github.com/react-R/reactR).

## Features

- Native Shiny cell inputs with explicit server acceptance or rejection
- Configurable editing indicators and disabled inputs by row, column, or
  cell
- Browser row addition and removal with Shiny callbacks
- Rich tooltips for cells, inputs, and headers
- Sorting, filtering, pagination
- Grouping and aggregation
- Built-in column formatting
- Custom rendering via R or JavaScript — use Shiny HTML tags and HTML
  widgets in tables
- Expandable rows and nested tables
- Conditional styling
- Virtual scrolling for large tables
- Works seamlessly within R Markdown documents and Shiny apps

## Installation

Install from a local checkout (the directory name does not need to match
the package name):

``` r

# Run from the checkout directory
install.packages(".", repos = NULL, type = "source")
```

Once the fork has been published to GitHub, install it with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("samuel-jobert/reactableEdit")
```

The package is loaded with
[`library(reactableEdit)`](https://github.com/samuel-jobert/reactableEdit).
Existing function names ([`reactable()`](reference/reactable.md),
[`colDef()`](reference/colDef.md),
[`reactableOutput()`](reference/reactable-shiny.md), etc.), the
`Reactable` JavaScript API, widget classes, and `reactable.*` options
are unchanged. Both R packages can be installed side by side, but avoid
loading them together or mixing their widgets in the same HTML document:
they share function names, widget bindings, and JavaScript globals.

## Usage

To create a table, use [`reactable()`](reference/reactable.md) on a data
frame or matrix:

``` r

library(reactableEdit)

reactable(iris)
```

[![reactable example using the iris
dataset](reference/figures/iris.png)](https://glin.github.io/reactable/articles/examples.html)

You can embed tables in **R Markdown** or **Quarto** documents:

    ```{r}
    library(reactableEdit)

    reactable(iris)
    ```

Or use them in **Shiny** applications:

``` r

library(shiny)
library(reactableEdit)

ui <- fluidPage(
  reactableOutput("table")
)

server <- function(input, output) {
  output$table <- renderReactable({
    reactable(iris)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui, server)
```

To learn more about the shared API, check out the upstream examples
below.

# Package index

## Create tables

- [`reactable()`](reactable.md) : Create an interactive data table

## Customize columns

- [`colDef()`](colDef.md) : Column definitions
- [`colGroup()`](colGroup.md) : Column group definitions
- [`colFormat()`](colFormat.md) : Column formatting options

## Customize tables

- [`reactableTheme()`](reactableTheme.md) : Theme options
- [`reactableLang()`](reactableLang.md) : Language options

## Use in Shiny apps

- [`reactableOutput()`](reactable-shiny.md)
  [`renderReactable()`](reactable-shiny.md) : Shiny bindings for
  reactable
- [`updateReactable()`](updateReactable.md) : Update a reactable
  instance
- [`getReactableState()`](getReactableState.md) : Get the state of a
  reactable instance

## Native cell editing

- [`getReactableEdit()`](reactable-editing.md)
  [`resolveReactableEdit()`](reactable-editing.md) : Get and resolve
  cell edits in Shiny
- [`updateReactableInput()`](updateReactableInput.md) : Disable or
  enable a mounted reactable input

## Row actions

- [`getReactableRowAction()`](reactable-row-actions.md)
  [`addReactableRow()`](reactable-row-actions.md) : Add and remove rows
  in Shiny

## Rich tooltips

- [`reactableTooltip()`](reactable-tooltips.md)
  [`updateReactableTooltip()`](reactable-tooltips.md) : Rich, accessible
  cell tooltips

## Custom server data backends

- [`reactableServerInit()`](reactable-server.md)
  [`reactableServerData()`](reactable-server.md) : Create custom
  server-side data backends for Shiny
- [`resolvedData()`](resolvedData.md) : The result from handling a
  server-side data request
